codeReview.summary: Current HEAD still contains the real provider exports and call sites: `providers/llm.ts` exports `chatCompletion()`/`extractIntent()`, `providers/embeddings.ts` exports `generateEmbedding()`, `routing/intent.ts` still calls `extractIntentWithTimeout()`, and `handlers/main.ts` still generates one `sharedQueryEmbedding` that it passes to both memory and RAG search. However, the prior blocking scrutiny finding is still unresolved. The only feature-specific tests remain tautological constant/object assertions that do not import or execute the provider modules or the live shared-embedding path, and `git log` for the relevant files still shows only the original provider/test commits (`a493955`, `7455b1d`) with no later fix. The advisory provider also still places context blocks in the user message rather than the system prompt required by the feature description.

issues.description: The prior blocking issue remains unresolved. This suite still never imports or executes `chatCompletion()`, `extractIntent()`, or their timeout wrappers from `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/providers/llm.ts`; representative assertions at lines 137-145, 349-361, and 547-548 only compare local literals or hand-built objects. Repo-wide search across `__tests__` found no `chatCompletion(`, `extractIntent(`, `chatCompletionWithTimeout(`, or `extractIntentWithTimeout(` call, so GPT-4o-mini advisory behavior, locale-specific system prompting, and JSON-mode extraction are still not meaningfully verified.

The prior blocking issue remains unresolved here as well. This suite still never imports or executes `generateEmbedding()` or the live shared-embedding call path; representative assertions at lines 112-114 and 349-380 only compare constants or a hand-built `sharedEmbedding` array. Repo-wide search across `__tests__` found no `generateEmbedding(` or `sharedQueryEmbedding`, so the real provider behavior and the single-embedding reuse implemented in `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/handlers/main.ts:290-311` / `context/{memory,rag}.ts` are still not behaviorally verified.

The advisory provider still appends `contextBlocks` to the user message (`role: 'user'` at lines 68-69) while the system message at lines 64-65 contains only language and safety instructions. The feature description explicitly required farm, memory, RAG, and attachment context to be injected into the advisory system prompt.
